csv_project_name: A/E for Student Success &Career Services Building Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: Architectural/engineering services for the construction of a project known as Project No. J-477, Renovations for Student Success and Career Services at Abraham Baldwin Agricultural College, Tifton, Georgia. This project is a comprehensive renovation of the former Music Building, a 14,850 GSF historic building built in 1960 as a library. Vacant since the construction of the new Fine Arts building in 2020, the building is proposed for renovation and adaptive reuse to provide space for the ABAC Student Success and Career Services center, as well as large, flexible meeting and event space for student and campus functions. The renovation scope will include comprehensive renewal and upgrade of the (largely original) mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems, including the conversion from two to four pipe chilled and hot water distribution to aid in dehumidification and Abraham Baldwin Agricultural College, J-477, Renovations for Student Success and Career Services. The scope also includes building envelope renewal (a new roof and the replacement of the large, historically significant single pane windows) and upgrades for building and accessibility code compliance (including an elevator). Interior renovation scope includes targeted reconfiguration to support new functions and the renewal or replacement of interior finishes and fixtures
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering
